We mourn the passing of vocalist Pt. Indudhar Nirody. The legend leaves a deep mark in the world of Indian classical music. Om Shanti.

Born in Udupi, Karnataka, Pt. Indudhar Nirody belonged to the Agra gharana; he received his training in music from many gurus such as Shri. Pitre Rama Rao, Shri. Gurudatt Heblekar, Pt. S. C. R Bhatt, Pt. K. G. Ginde, Pt. Dinkar Kaikini and Pt. Chidanand Nagarkar. Gifted with a robust and vibrant voice, Pt. Indudhar ji carved out a niche for himself in the field of Hindustani music. He was a top-grade artist of All India Radio.
